name: medical-s4-integration-mini
description: Integrate bounded medical-research evidence, analyses, and intermediate artifacts into a traceable draft for validation.
---

# Research integration

1. Link only approved evidence and artifact identifiers in the integration
   draft.
2. Separate observations, transformations, assumptions, and conclusions.
3. Reconcile contradictory evidence and make unresolved limitations explicit.
4. Validate the integrated draft before protocol drafting or structured
   delivery; do not add unobserved results to make a narrative complete.
